findings.title: Fallback locale files are not loaded on the translation path
findings.body: Server-side fallbacks cannot work unless the fallback YAML is actually loaded, but I18n.translate only calls load_locale for config.locale. The on-demand loader (load_translations patched to load nothing unless given filenames) will not pull in SiteSetting.default_locale or :en. The new ensure_loaded! helper is only invoked from ApplicationController#set_locale (line 159), so background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, and any I18n.with_locale / I18n.t(..., locale:) call that does not go through that before_filter look up fallback locales in an empty store and treat real English (or site-default) strings as missing. That is the main server-side path this change is for: notification emails run outside ApplicationController. It is worse with the LRU cache: getset memoizes the result of translate_no_cache under a key that does not record which locales were loaded. If a missing-translation handler returns a string (instead of raising), that miss is frozen in the cache, and a later ensure_loaded! cannot repair hot keys. Interpolated lookups (args.length > 0) skip the cache but still do not load the fallback chain. Load the fallback chain inside translate before lookup/cache fill, including an explicit locale: option, instead of relying on the controller filter.

findings.title: Translation cache key ignores the fallback locale
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList resolves missing keys through SiteSetting.default_locale, which admins can change at runtime without a process restart, but the accelerator cache key is only "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}". A string resolved via the old site locale is stored under the user locale and reused after default_locale changes. Hot keys stay in the 300-entry LRU indefinitely, so users keep seeing the previous fallback language until restart. Include the fallback chain (at least SiteSetting.default_locale) in the cache key, or clear this cache when default_locale changes.

findings.title: No tests for fallback order or fallback bundle loading
findings.body: The new contract is locale, then SiteSetting.default_locale, then :en, and it depends on on-demand YAML loading that previously only happened for the active locale. Nothing in this change covers that order, the ApplicationController ensure_loaded! hook, or a non-request entry point such as a job or mailer. Those paths are exactly where fallback files are not loaded, so the feature can ship while still returning missing-translation results for incomplete locales outside HTTP requests.
